policy.confidenceMeaning: Purchase evidence confidence measures how well the purchase channel, price and terms are documented. It is not a reputation score or fraud probability.
policy.reviewsRule: Independent review ratings are dated context only. They never become a trust score and never override first-party terms or direct product evidence.
policy.costRule: Cost windows are base-cost estimates only when the underlying billing cycle is explicit. Taxes, usage, optional add-ons, shipping and promotions stay separate unless explicitly included.
policy.temporarySmsRule: Do not calculate expected successful cost from seller-reported success rates. A success-adjusted cost needs an independent or audited denominator and refund outcome data.
